test.create_query: CREATE TABLE for_each_bench (k UInt32, arr Array(Float64)) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO for_each_bench SELECT number % 1000, arrayMap(i -> toFloat64(i + number), range(32)) FROM numbers(2000000)
test.query: SELECT sumForEach(arr) FROM for_each_bench FORMAT Null
SELECT avgForEach(arr) FROM for_each_bench FORMAT Null
SELECT quantilesForEach(0.5, 0.9)(arr) FROM for_each_bench FORMAT Null
SELECT k, sumForEach(arr) FROM for_each_bench GROUP BY k FORMAT Null
SELECT k, quantilesForEach(0.5, 0.9)(arr) FROM for_each_bench GROUP BY k FORMAT Null
